LLC, Sumitomo Chemical Brasil Industria Quimica S.A., Sumitomo Chemical Chile S.A., Sumitomo Chemical India Limited, among others. entries.2ac5e195cbf695b0: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells optical products, semiconductor process materials, compound semiconductor materials, touch sensor panels, high-purity aluminum and alumina, chemical products, additives, engineering plastics, battery components and other products. These are handled by Toyu Fine Chem Co., Ltd., Sumika Semiconductor Materials Texas, Inc., SSLM Co., Ltd., Sumika Electronic Materials Technology (Wuxi) Co., Ltd., Sumika Technology Co., Ltd., Tanaka Kagaku Kenkyusho Co., Ltd., and Taoka Chemical Co., Ltd., among others. The number of employees, 9,563, was the largest of the six business segments, and capital expenditure of ¥52,970 million was also the largest. The company cites as reasons for the revenue decline the fall in selling prices of display-related materials, the impact of fundamental structural reform of the polarizing film business for large liquid crystal displays (LCDs), and lower export proceeds accompanying the stronger yen. On the other hand, it states that semiconductor process materials continued to recover gradually in market conditions and shipment volumes increased. entries.2ac7a91be7edd9ef: This is a reportable segment engaged in CDMO (process development and contract manufacturing) business in the advanced small-molecule pharmaceuticals, medical oligonucleotide and regenerative and cell medicine fields, among others. Koei Chemical Co., Ltd. and others take charge of it. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥58,601 million (down 5.7% year on year), segment profit (core operating profit) was ¥2,818 million, and the number of employees was 2,161. The company explains that while production of oligonucleotides ramped up in earnest and shipments increased, there were differences in product mix for active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates. In medical oligonucleotides, it strengthened its customer support structure by leveraging its U.S. base, and in regenerative and cell medicine, Amchepry®, the world's first iPS cell-derived product for Parkinson's disease treatment approved in Japan, received conditional and time-limited approval. The company positions its CDMO business as the core of its growth.

entries.fca75f02c54d1dca: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,328,515 million, a decrease of ¥277.8 billion from the previous fiscal year. Revenue to external customers by segment was ¥678,800 million for Essential & Green Materials, ¥574,162 million for ICT & Mobility Solutions, ¥519,256 million for Agro & Life Solutions, ¥451,933 million for Sumitomo Pharma, ¥58,601 million for Advanced Medical Solutions and ¥45,763 million for Other. The company explains that the reasons for the decrease in revenue were a decrease in shipments by a sales subsidiary accompanying periodic maintenance at Petro Rabigh in Essential & Green Materials, a decrease in shipments of aluminum and other products accompanying business withdrawal in the previous consolidated fiscal year, a decrease in shipments of synthetic resins accompanying a business transfer in the current consolidated fiscal year, and the sale and deconsolidation of the radiopharmaceutical business and other businesses in the previous consolidated fiscal year. Because its production items are wide-ranging and diverse, the company does not show the production scale of each segment in monetary terms, and states it on a sales price basis as approximately ¥256 billion for Agro & Life Solutions, approximately ¥524 billion for ICT & Mobility Solutions, approximately ¥60 billion for Advanced Medical Solutions, approximately ¥458 billion for Essential & Green Materials and approximately ¥408 billion for Sumitomo Pharma.
entries.fe0a19176bf2b677: The Sumitomo Chemical Group consists of the company and 214 affiliated companies, and has adopted a business division system in which business is divided by the products and services handled and production, sales and research are operated in an integrated manner. The reporting segments are the 5 segments "Agro & Life Solutions," "ICT & Mobility Solutions," "Advanced Medical Solutions," "Essential & Green Materials" and "Sumitomo Pharma," and in addition there is "Other," which is not included in the reporting segments. This classification was created in October 2024 by reorganizing the former divisions of Essential Chemicals, Energy & Functional Materials, IT-related Chemicals, Health & Crop Sciences and Pharmaceuticals. Under Sumitomo's business spirit of "Benefit for self and others, private and public interests are one and the same," the company has set the corporate image it aims for over the long term as an "Innovative Solution Provider" and has placed the social issues it should address as the 4 issues of "food," "ICT," "healthcare" and "the environment." Its customers are wide-ranging, including farmers, medical care, electrical and semiconductor, and automobiles, and no customer accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue in revenue to external customers. Segment profit or loss is presented as "core operating profit," calculated by excluding profit or loss arising from non-recurring factors from operating profit or loss. In its medium-term management plan from fiscal 2025, it sets out 5 basic policies, including "advancement of the business portfolio through a new growth strategy," "strengthening through the continued implementation of structural reforms" and "improvement of financial and capital efficiency," and sets core operating profit of ¥200 billion for fiscal 2027 as its financial target.
